subject: Confidentiality & Publicity — CloudWave MSA publicity carveouts
messages:
From: Hannah Li <hannah.li@cloudwave.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@cloudwave.com>, legal@cloudwave.com
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Confidentiality & Publicity — MSA/Order Form Redlines

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the draft MSA and the attached order form. Our legal team has a few redlines they wanted to call out specifically around publicity and confidentiality:

1) Publicity carveouts — we push back on a blanket "publicity" clause. We need the ability to issue joint press releases for product integrations where CloudWave is the primary customer; suggest a mutual-notification + 10 business day opt-out window.

2) Logo use — CloudWave requires a narrow, brand-guideline-compliant logo usage clause. Any co-marketing must be pre-approved by our brand team (Alex is CC'd).

3) Confidentiality exception for aggregated analytics — our product analytics team needs an explicit exception to use aggregate, non-identifying metrics for internal performance dashboards.

I've attached the redlines (CloudWave_MSA_OrderForm_Redline.pdf) and highlighted the affected sections. From our side these are standard; if Redwood needs tightened language around customer data we can iterate.

Can you confirm who at Redwood will own publicity approvals and whether Marketing can be looped into the review?

Appreciate it,

— Hannah Li
Legal Counsel, CloudWave
Hannah.Li@cloudwave.com

Attachment: CloudWave_MSA_OrderForm_Redline.pdf (pdf)

From: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Li <hannah.li@cloudwave.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Confidentiality & Publicity — MSA/Order Form Redlines

Hannah — thanks for the clear notes and the redline PDF. Looping in Kim (legal) and Marissa (marketing) so we can resolve language quickly.

High level response:
- Publicity carveouts: Redwood is typically comfortable with mutual notification + 15 business day opt-out for joint announcements. If CloudWave needs 10 business days, we can accept 10 but would like the ability to escalate to an exec approval for exceptions.
- Logo use: we agree to a brand-guideline lock; Marissa will confirm acceptable asset usage and a sign-off workflow.
- Aggregated analytics: sounds reasonable as long as it is expressly non-personally-identifiable and cannot be reconstituted to PII — Kim, any suggested wording?

Next steps: Kim will propose precise contract language. Marissa will send the Redwood publicity approval take (templated sign-off form + expected SLAs). Ben — aware this may affect launch timing; can you confirm whether 10 vs 15 days impacts our delivery timeline?

Thanks,
Olga
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Hannah Li <hannah.li@cloudwave.com>, Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@cloudwave.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Confidentiality & Publicity — CloudWave MSA publicity carveouts

Team — putting proposed redline language below (quick draft for negotiation). I'll send a tracked-change version to Hannah tomorrow.

Publicity — Joint Announcements:
"Neither Party shall issue any public announcement or press release regarding the business relationship, the existence of this Agreement, or commercial terms without the prior written consent of the other Party, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed. For joint announcements, the notifying Party shall provide a written draft to the other Party and the receiving Party shall have ten (10) business days to approve or reasonably object. If no response is received within ten (10) business days, consent shall be deemed granted. Notwithstanding the foregoing, either Party may make a public announcement where required by applicable law or regulation."

Logo Use:
"Customer may use Vendor's name and logo solely in accordance with Vendor's brand guidelines and only after obtaining prior written approval from Vendor's marketing contact. Vendor will provide a review decision within five (5) business days of submission of artwork and proposed copy; if no decision is provided within such timeframe, approval will be deemed granted."

Aggregated Analytics Exception:
"Notwithstanding the Confidentiality provisions, Vendor may use aggregated, de-identified performance metrics derived from Customer's usage data for internal analytics, benchmarking, and product improvement, provided such data cannot be re-identified and is presented in aggregate form. Vendor shall not use such data for Customer-specific marketing or sales collateral without Customer's prior written consent."

I recommend we accept the 10 business day joint-announcement window but keep the five-day SLA for marketing asset reviews on our side. If CloudWave insists on longer, we should require an exec-level exception route.

— Kim
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Li <hannah.li@cloudwave.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Confidentiality & Publicity — CloudWave MSA publicity carveouts

Kim/Olga — thanks for the proposed language, that looks close. A couple of small requests:

- The 10 business day auto-grant is acceptable, but CloudWave asks that approval be expressly required for any usage of CloudWave's customer logo in third-party marketing (i.e., not deemed granted). We can accept your 5 business day turnaround for vendor-provided assets.

- On aggregated analytics, please add a sentence that any benchmarking report that includes CloudWave will only include CloudWave with prior written consent.

I've attached a quick markup of your draft and removed / replaced a few phrases (see CloudWave_MSA_OrderForm_Redline.pdf).

Assuming Kim's edits + these two small items, legal is comfortable moving to internal exec approval on both sides (so we can lock language and proceed to signature).

If Redwood can send a clean tracked version with the two tweaks by EOD, we'll push to signature.

Best,
— Hannah
Legal Counsel, CloudWave

Attachment: CloudWave_MSA_OrderForm_Redline.pdf (pdf)

2) Marketing approvals: Marissa to prepare the Redwood publicity approval form and the 5-business-day review SLA. Also share a sample signed approval for prior launches. Due: EOD tomorrow.
3) Sales/timing: Ben to confirm whether a 10-business-day announcement window changes our go-to-market timeline for the joint integration launch; flag if need to request a shorter turnaround. Due: EOD Wednesday.
4) Attachments: keep the CloudWave redline in the deal folder and upload the Redwood publicity guidelines (Redwood_Publicity_Guidelines_v3.docx) so CloudWave can see our review flow.

I'll own the exec escalation if either side needs sign-off faster. Once Kim posts the clean tracked version we'll send back to Hannah for final sign-off and then to legal execs.

Thanks — Olga
